name: launch-seo-np
description: Search visibility for a Nepal launch: launch-page SEO checks (titles, headings, NPR Product schema, Open Graph previews for Facebook and Viber sharing, mobile speed on mid-range Android); search-word maps in English, Nepali and Romanized Nepali; Google Business Profile and local 'near me' checks for places without formal street addresses; and AI answer visibility with prompt panels in three scripts. Evidence-based; no fake reviews or invented search volumes.
